vendor/palisade — VENDOR PROVENANCE
===================================

WHAT THIS IS
  Palisade, the C-only sandbox core: stage3.c (the layer sequence
  nnprivs -> landlock -> rlimits -> seccomp, then exec) plus the patched
  cosmocc pledge (src/palisade/cosmo/pledge-{linux,rattan}.c).  Its interface
  is

      stage3 PROMISES LANDLOCK_SPEC [--verify] -- cmd [args...]

  Vendored as SOURCE so this tree can modify it deliberately; the binary is
  NOT vendored — it is built here by `make palisade` (see the top-level
  Makefile) into build/stage3.

ORIGIN                                                   [MEASURED 2026-10-18]
  origin repo:   https://github.com/fixpoint-linux/palisade
  vendored from: ~/fixpoint-linux/fxstore/vendor/palisade (a git submodule of
                 the fxstore checkout)
  fxstore HEAD at copy time:  e97758c92fbe78227b855ac9e82da64aaba58c3a
  palisade commit at copy:    3c7dc1bd59d7d3598ddaa4401441950a5915ecc7
                              (git -C ~/fixpoint-linux/fxstore/vendor/palisade
                               rev-parse HEAD, at that fxstore HEAD)
  copy date:     2026-10-18
  copied:        README.md Makefile .gitignore Dhakefile.dhall
                 src/palisade/stage3.c src/palisade/cosmo/{pledge-linux.c,
                 pledge-rattan.c,README.md} tests/probes/*.c
  NOT copied:    bin/ — that directory held the submodule's own BUILD OUTPUTS
                 (stage3, .ape, .com.dbg, .aarch64/).  They are upstream
                 build artifacts, not source, and are gitignored upstream.

  Every copied file is byte-identical to its origin (proven at copy time with
  `cmp` over all 13 files).  The vendored tree is otherwise UNMODIFIED — this
  slice (S0) changes nothing in it; the only files added here are this
  VENDOR.txt and PINS.

THIS TREE OWNS ITS COPY
  There is NO dependency on the fxstore checkout for palisade: nothing here
  is read from ~/fixpoint-linux/fxstore, and `make palisade` builds from the
  sources in THIS directory.  (tools/stage-guest.sh still reads the fxstore
  checkout for the IN-GUEST fxstore BUILDER — a different, unchanged
  dependency.)  From here on, a palisade change is a deliberate local change
  to THIS copy; upstream is a reference to diff against, not a source to
  follow.

RESYNC (when upstream moves)
  cp the source list above over this directory, re-record the two commit
  shas and the date in this file, then `make palisade-repro` to re-measure
  byte-reproducibility and update PINS with the sha it reports.  A pin change
  is a release: it changes the sandbox binary the guest receives.

PIN
  PINS holds `stage3<TAB>sha256` for the binary `make palisade` produces.
  `make palisade` refuses (loudly) when the built binary does not match the
  pin: a toolchain drift or a source edit cannot silently swap the sandbox
  binary that goes into the guest.  MEASURED reproducible: two clean builds
  in-tree, and a clean build in a different absolute path, all produced the
  same sha256.
